description: This file defines the CountryService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for accessing and managing country and province data via a DAO layer and normalizing data for external use.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to retrieve country and province data, interact with DAO layer, and normalize data into models.

methods.name: getCountryDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the instance of CountryDao.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Retrieves a Country entity based on country name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Country entity based on country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Province entity based on province code.

methods.name: getCountryArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of country models.

methods.name: getProvinceArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of province models.
